status.scope_reason: Camber Pharmaceuticals commercially markets a generic formulation of sacubitril/valsartan tablets in the United States.
status.evidence: According to a press announcement published by Carlisle Medical, Camber is one of several manufacturers releasing a generic formulation of Sacubitril/Valsartan tablets following its recent FDA approval.

claims.claim: The company reports a generic formulation of sacubitril and valsartan tablets, which was included in its Q3 2025 product lineup expansion according to a company announcement on Camber Pharmaceuticals.

The company markets generic sacubitril and valsartan oral film-coated tablets across three strengths including 24 mg/26 mg, 49 mg/51 mg, and 97 mg/103 mg, as detailed in product specifications on Camber Pharmaceuticals.
The company's generic sacubitril and valsartan product labels indicate that the formulation is manufactured by Hetero Labs Limited based in Hyderabad, India, as verified on Camber Pharmaceuticals.

The company's sacubitril and valsartan product lineup includes only film-coated tablets and lacks oral pellets or sprinkle alternatives, as documented on the official product index of Camber Pharmaceuticals.

Camber Pharmaceuticals' generic sacubitril and valsartan tablets are manufactured by Hetero Labs Limited at its facility in Jeedimetla, Hyderabad, India under Manufacturing License No. 22/RR/AP/2001/F/R.
Camber Pharmaceuticals established its supply presence by commercially launching its generic sacubitril/valsartan tablets in the U.S. market during Q3 2025.
Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc. launched generic sacubitril/valsartan film-coated tablets in the U.S. market in Q3 2025 following the formulation's regulatory clearance.
The product label for generic sacubitril/valsartan tablets distributed by Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc. confirms manufacturing by partner Hetero Labs Limited in Jeedimetla, Hyderabad, India.

Camber Pharmaceuticals Inc. received FDA approval under ANDA 213668 for its generic sacubitril and valsartan film-coated tablets on July 23, 2025, according to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration's National Drug Code database.
claims.corrected: Hetero Labs Ltd III received FDA approval under ANDA 213668 for its generic sacubitril and valsartan film-coated tablets on July 17, 2025, according to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration's Orange Book.

claims.claim: The company reports that its distribution process achieved compliance with Drug Supply Chain Security Act (DSCSA) tracking requirements starting in August 2024, with 100% full packaging aggregation from bottle to pallet.

As per our findings, the company has not disclosed two FDA inspections with its most recent inspection closed cleanly in November 2022 resulting in no Form 483 issuance, according to Atlas Compliance inspection tracking data.
claims.note: The details regarding two undisclosed FDA inspections and the clean November 2022 inspection closure resulting in no Form 483 issuance are unconfirmed.
claims.source: Atlas Compliance Tracking Site and FDA Records

claims.claim: The company reports its generic Sacubitril and Valsartan Tablets are supplied as standard film-coated oral tablets debossed with 'H' on one side and a code ('S24', 'S25', or 'S26') on the other, mirroring the reference product's strengths without proprietary formulation modifications, as seen in Camber Pharmaceuticals Product Documents.
claims.corrected: The company reports its generic Sacubitril and Valsartan Tablets are supplied as film-coated oral tablets debossed with 'H' on one side and a code ('S24', 'S25', or 'S26') on the other, with strengths of 24 mg/26 mg (white, oval), 49 mg/51 mg (blue, oval), and 97 mg/103 mg (brown, oval), mirroring the reference product's strengths without proprietary formulation modifications, as seen in Camber Pharmaceuticals Product Documents.
claims.note: The tablets are not all single 'standard' colors; they vary by strength (white, blue, and brown) as documented in Camber's official product specifications.
claims.source: Camber Pharmaceuticals Product Documents (Sacubitril and Valsartan Tablets Product Specifications and Patient Information Leaflets)

claims.claim: The company reports that its generic formulation requires standard storage parameters to protect from moisture at controlled room temperatures of 20ºC to 25ºC (68ºF to 77ºF) without unique environmental stability extensions, according to the Camber Pharmaceuticals Prescribing Labels.
claims.source: Camber Pharmaceuticals Prescribing Labels (Sacubitril and Valsartan Labels)

claims.claim: The company reports that direct sales are restricted exclusively to licensed drug wholesalers, retail chains with operational warehouses or distribution centers, and contract purchasers including federal government facilities, according to its official Camber Pharmaceuticals Partner Resources.
claims.source: Camber Pharmaceuticals Partner Resources (Partner Resources & Consumer Care Legal Policies)

claims.claim: Camber Pharmaceuticals maintains multiple U.S. warehouses and distribution centers encompassing nearly 500,000 square feet of storage capacity, as documented in its Corporate Milestones announcement.
claims.source: Camber Pharmaceuticals Corporate Announcements (15 Years of Success Corporate Milestones Announcement)

claims.claim: Camber Pharmaceuticals expanded its channel engagements by hosting nearly 100 customer and partner meetings at the National Association of Chain Drug Stores Total Store Expo to solidify distribution accounts, as detailed in its Q3 2025 Portfolio Update.
The company reports having a "well-established sales force of industry veterans" and a dedicated Business Development team for the commercialization and distribution of its generic drug pipeline.
The company launched its generic Sacubitril/Valsartan Tablets (the generic equivalent of branded ENTRESTO) in Q3 2025 to expand its commercial prescription drug portfolio in the United States.

Camber Pharmaceuticals operates as the dedicated US sales and marketing entity for the prescription products of its parent company, Hetero, utilizing an integrated supply chain that spans from active pharmaceutical ingredients to marketing and distribution.
The company operates as a rapidly growing generics player in the United States with more than 80 associates, multiple distribution centers, and historical overall sales exceeding 1.5 billion dollars.
Camber Pharmaceuticals expanded its generic portfolio through the commercial launch of Sacubitril/Valsartan Tablets in Q3 2025, according to a product portfolio update on Camber Pharmaceuticals.

Manufacturing partner Hetero Labs Limited received U.S. FDA final approval for its Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA 213668) for sacubitril and valsartan tablets on July 17, 2025, according to the regulatory approvals listing.
claims.source: Pharmabiz US FDA ANDA Approvals Directory (https://pharmabiz.com) and Drugs.com Generic Entresto Availability Listing (https://www.drugs.com/availability/generic-entresto.html)

claims.claim: The company reports it executed a generic Sacubitril/Valsartan Tablets launch in Q3 2025.
The company launched generic Sacubitril/Valsartan Tablets in the U.S. marketplace in Q3 2025.
